Funciones de escritura segura
```{r}
safe_write_tsv <- function(df, path, fallback_dir = project_dir) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".tsv")
  ok <- FALSE
  
  tryCatch({
    readr::write_tsv(df, tmp)
    file.copy(tmp, path, overwrite = TRUE)
    ok <<- TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error escribiendo en ", path, ". Se usará carpeta de respaldo.")
    message("Detalle: ", e$message)
  })
  
  if (!ok) {
    fallback_path <- file.path(fallback_dir, basename(path))
    readr::write_tsv(df, fallback_path)
    message("Guardado en respaldo: ", fallback_path)
  }
  
  invisible(path)
}

safe_ggsave <- function(filename, plot, path = file.path(project_dir, "results", "figures"),
                        fallback_dir = project_dir, ...) {
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  full_path <- file.path(path, filename)
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = paste0(".", tools::file_ext(filename)))
  
  ok <- FALSE
  
  tryCatch({
    ggplot2::ggsave(tmp, plot = plot, ...)
    file.copy(tmp, full_path, overwrite = TRUE)
    ok <<- TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error guardando figura en ", full_path, ". Se usará carpeta de respaldo.")
    message("Detalle: ", e$message)
  })
  
  if (!ok) {
    fallback_path <- file.path(fallback_dir, filename)
    ggplot2::ggsave(fallback_path, plot = plot, ...)
    message("Figura guardada en respaldo: ", fallback_path)
  }
  
  invisible(full_path)
}
```

Normalizadores de IDs y funciones composicionales
Estas funciones hacen 3 cosas clave:
Estandarizar IDs (quitar espacios, poner mayúsculas).
Pasar a proporciones (cada muestra suma 1).
Aplicar pseudoconteo + CLR (para datos composicionales).

```{r}
# Limpia UniRef (sin espacios, mayúsculas)
std_uniref <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  toupper(x)
}

# Limpia KOs (garantiza KXXXXX)
std_ko <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(toupper(x))
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  # Si viene sólo 5 dígitos, agrega la K
  mask5 <- grepl("^\\d{5}$", x)
  x[mask5] <- paste0("K", x[mask5])
  x
}

# Convierte columnas de muestra en proporciones por muestra (cada columna suma 1)
to_proportions <- function(df, sample_cols) {
  mat <- as.matrix(df[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
  col_sums <- colSums(mat)
  mat <- sweep(mat, 2, col_sums, FUN = "/")
  df[, sample_cols] <- mat
  df
}

# Agrega pseudoconteo por muestra: mitad del mínimo no-cero de esa muestra
pseudocount_per_sample <- function(df, sample_cols) {
  mat <- as.matrix(df[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(mat))) {
    col <- mat[, j]
    min_pos <- suppressWarnings(min(col[col > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.finite(min_pos)) {
      pseudo <- min_pos / 2
      col <- col + pseudo
    }
    mat[, j] <- col
  }
  df[, sample_cols] <- mat
  df
}

# Transformación CLR: log(x) - media(log(x)) por muestra
clr_transform <- function(df, sample_cols) {
  mat <- as.matrix(df[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
  log_mat <- log(mat)
  means <- colMeans(log_mat)
  clr_mat <- sweep(log_mat, 2, means, FUN = "-")
  df[, sample_cols] <- clr_mat
  df
}

```

Cliffs delta

```{r}
cliffs_delta <- function(x, g) {
  # x = vector numérico (CLR), g = factor de grupos (ej. "CC" y "VG")
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  g <- g[!is.na(g)]
  stopifnot(length(x) == length(g))
  
  grupos <- levels(factor(g))
  if (length(grupos) != 2) stop("cliffs_delta necesita exactamente 2 grupos.")
  
  x1 <- x[g == grupos[1]]
  x2 <- x[g == grupos[2]]
  
  # Todas las comparaciones par a par
  diffs <- outer(x1, x2, "-")
  delta <- (sum(diffs > 0) - sum(diffs < 0)) / (length(x1) * length(x2))
  
  delta
}

```

Mapeos + construcción de tablas base
2.1 – Cargar y autodetectar KO → nombre
```{r}
# 2.1 KO -> Nombre

ko_name_path <- file.path(project_dir, "uniref_mapping_reducido", "ko_name_reduced.tsv")

ko_raw <- readr::read_tsv(ko_name_path, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

# Detectar columna KO (por patrón KXXXXX)
is_ko_col <- sapply(ko_raw, function(col) any(grepl("^K\\d{5}$", std_ko(col))))
ko_colname <- names(ko_raw)[is_ko_col][1]

# Detectar la mejor columna de nombre: la de texto más largo
name_col_candidates <- setdiff(names(ko_raw), ko_colname)
name_colname <- name_col_candidates[
  which.max(
    sapply(ko_raw[name_col_candidates], function(col) mean(nchar(col), na.rm = TRUE))
  )
]

ko_names <- ko_raw %>%
  transmute(
    KO = std_ko(.data[[ko_colname]]),
    ko_name = .data[[name_colname]]
  ) %>%
  distinct()

ko_names %>% head()

```
```{r}
# 2.2 UniRef -> KO

uniref_ko_path <- file.path(project_dir, "uniref_mapping_reducido", "uniref90_ko_reduced_long.tsv")

uniref_ko_raw <- readr::read_tsv(uniref_ko_path, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

# Autodetectar columna UniRef
is_uniref_col <- sapply(uniref_ko_raw, function(col) any(grepl("UNIREF", toupper(col))))
uniref_colname <- names(uniref_ko_raw)[is_uniref_col][1]

# Autodetectar columna KO
is_ko_col2 <- sapply(uniref_ko_raw, function(col) any(grepl("^K\\d{5}$", std_ko(col))))
ko_colname2 <- names(uniref_ko_raw)[is_ko_col2][1]

uniref_ko <- uniref_ko_raw %>%
  transmute(
    Gene_Family = std_uniref(.data[[uniref_colname]]),
    KO          = std_ko(.data[[ko_colname2]])
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# Añadir pesos: UniRef que mapearon a varios KO reparten abundancia
uniref_ko_weights <- uniref_ko %>%
  group_by(Gene_Family) %>%
  mutate(
    n_ko = n(),
    weight = 1 / n_ko
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

uniref_ko_weights %>% head()
```

Definir los gene sets por categoría

```{r}
# 2.4 Definir categorías

category_patterns <- list(
  Glucosa_central = "(glycolysis|pyruvate|gluconeogenesis|fructose|glyceraldehyde)",
  UV_repair       = "(photolyase|uv|dna repair|nucleotide excision)",
  Photosynthesis  = "(photosystem|chlorophyll|bacteriochlorophyll|light-harvesting)",
  Nitrogen        = "(nitrate reductase|nitrogenase|glutamine synthetase|ammonia|denitrif)"
)

assign_category <- function(name) {
  name_low <- tolower(name %||% "")
  cats <- names(Filter(function(pat) str_detect(name_low, pat), category_patterns))
  if (length(cats) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  paste(cats, collapse = ";")
}

genesets_by_category <- ko_by_sample %>%
  mutate(category = vapply(ko_name, assign_category, character(1))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  select(KO, ko_name, category)

genesets_by_category_path <- file.path(project_dir, "results", "tables", "genesets_by_category.tsv")
safe_write_tsv(genesets_by_category, genesets_by_category_path)

genesets_by_category %>% head()
```

```{r}
category_diff <- cat_clr_long %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_CC = sum(Desierto == "CC"),
    n_VG = sum(Desierto == "VG"),
    mean_CLR_CC = mean(CLR[Desierto == "CC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_CLR_VG = mean(CLR[Desierto == "VG"], na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_meanCLR = mean_CLR_VG - mean_CLR_CC,
    p_value = wilcox.test(CLR[Desierto == "VG"], CLR[Desierto == "CC"])$p.value,
    cliffs_delta = cliffs_delta(CLR, Desierto),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

safe_write_tsv(category_diff,
               file.path(project_dir, "results", "tables", "category_differential.tsv"))

```

```{r}
# 4.4 – Heatmaps de KOs significativos (q <= 0.1)

alpha_heatmap <- 0.1

for (cat in unique(ko_diff_all$category)) {
  sig_kos <- ko_diff_all %>%
    filter(category == cat, p_adj <= alpha_heatmap) %>%
    pull(KO)
  
  if (!length(sig_kos)) next
  
  mat_cat <- ko_clr %>%
    filter(KO %in% sig_kos) %>%
    select(KO, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("KO") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # Z-score por KO (fila)
  mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat_cat)))
  
  # Anotación de columnas
  annot_col <- metadata %>%
    select(sample_column, Desierto) %>%
    column_to_rownames("sample_column")
  
  # Título SOLO con ASCII y limpiado con iconv (por si algo raro se cuela)
  title_main <- paste("KOs significativos (q <= 0.1) -", cat)
  title_main <- iconv(title_main, from = "", to = "latin1", sub = ".")
  
  fname <- paste0("heatmap_KO_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", cat), ".png")
  
  png(file.path(project_dir, "results", "figures", fname),
      width = 900, height = 1200)
  pheatmap(mat_z,
           annotation_col = annot_col,
           main = title_main,
           fontsize_row = 6)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
plot_lollipop_category <- function(cat, df = ko_sig, top_n = 15) {
  
  df2 <- df %>% 
    filter(category == cat) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(cliffs_delta))) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>% 
    mutate(label = ifelse(!is.na(ko_name), ko_name, KO),
           label = str_trunc(label, width = 50),
           direction = if_else(diff_meanCLR > 0, "VG>CC", "CC>VG"))
  
  if(nrow(df2) == 0){
    message("No significant KOs for category: ", cat)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = reorder(label, cliffs_delta), y = cliffs_delta, color = direction)) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = label, y = 0, yend = cliffs_delta), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title = paste("Lollipop plot –", cat),
         x = "KO (abreviado)", y = "Cliff’s delta (tamaño de efecto)") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("VG>CC" = "#00BFC4", "CC>VG" = "#F8766D"))
  
  # Guardado seguro
  safe_ggsave(
    filename = paste0("lollipop_cliff_", cat, ".png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 8, height = 6
  )
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}

ko_lolli_all <- ko_diff_all %>%
  # Solo KOs con tamaño de efecto y significativos
  filter(!is.na(cliffs_delta), p_adj <= 0.1) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  # Top |Cliff’s delta| dentro de cada categoría
  slice_max(order_by = abs(cliffs_delta),
            n = top_n_effect,
            with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(diff_meanCLR > 0, "VG>CC", "CC>VG"),
    # Etiqueta: nombre del KO o el ID si no lo hay
    label = ifelse(!is.na(ko_name) & ko_name != "", ko_name, KO),
    label = stringr::str_trunc(label, width = 45)  # recorta para que quepa
  )
```

```{r bloque_6_genesets_y_abundancia_categoria, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 6. DEFINICIÓN DE GENESETS Y ABUNDANCIA POR CATEGORÍA
# ============================================================

log_section("BLOQUE 6. Definición de genesets por categoría funcional")

log_msg("Razón del bloque:")
log_msg("Asignar KOs a categorías funcionales usando los patrones originales del protocolo base.")
log_msg("Después, sumar las abundancias de los KOs dentro de cada categoría.")
log_msg("Este bloque alimenta los análisis por categoría y las figuras posteriores.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.1 Cargar objetos necesarios
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ko_by_sample <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "05_KO_by_sample.rds"))
sample_cols <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "02B_sample_cols.rds"))
metadata <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "03_metadata_ordenada_como_sample_cols.rds"))

log_msg("Objetos cargados:")
log_msg("- ko_by_sample")
log_msg("- sample_cols")
log_msg("- metadata")

log_msg("Dimensiones de ko_by_sample: ", nrow(ko_by_sample), " filas x ", ncol(ko_by_sample), " columnas")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.2 Definir patrones originales de categorías
# ------------------------------------------------------------

category_patterns <- list(
  Glucosa_central = "(glycolysis|pyruvate|gluconeogenesis|fructose|glyceraldehyde)",
  UV_repair       = "(photolyase|uv|dna repair|nucleotide excision)",
  Photosynthesis  = "(photosystem|chlorophyll|bacteriochlorophyll|light-harvesting)",
  Nitrogen        = "(nitrate reductase|nitrogenase|glutamine synthetase|ammonia|denitrif)"
)

category_patterns_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  category = names(category_patterns),
  pattern = unlist(category_patterns),
  status = "FROZEN_DO_NOT_MODIFY",
  reason = "Patrones originales del protocolo base; no se modifican para conservar los mismos valores y figuras."
)

log_table(
  category_patterns_tbl,
  "06_patrones_categoria_originales",
  n = 10
)

safe_write_tsv(
  category_patterns_tbl,
  file.path(dir_qc, "06_patrones_categoria_originales.tsv"),
  reason = "Registrar los patrones originales usados para asignar KOs a categorías funcionales."
)

log_msg("Patrones de categoría definidos exactamente como en el protocolo base.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.3 Función original para asignar categoría
# ------------------------------------------------------------

assign_category <- function(name) {
  name_low <- tolower(name %||% "")
  cats <- names(Filter(function(pat) stringr::str_detect(name_low, pat), category_patterns))
  if (length(cats) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  paste(cats, collapse = ";")
}

log_msg("Función assign_category() definida como en el protocolo base.")
log_msg("Razón: asignar categorías funcionales a partir del texto de ko_name.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.4 Asignar KOs a categorías funcionales
# ------------------------------------------------------------

genesets_by_category <- ko_by_sample %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = vapply(ko_name, assign_category, character(1))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  dplyr::select(KO, ko_name, category)

log_table(
  genesets_by_category,
  "06_genesets_by_category",
  n = 20
)

genesets_summary <- genesets_by_category %>%
  dplyr::count(category, name = "n_KOs") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category)

log_table(
  genesets_summary,
  "06_resumen_KOs_por_categoria",
  n = 20
)

safe_write_tsv(
  genesets_by_category,
  file.path(dir_tables, "genesets_by_category.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar la tabla de KOs asignados a categorías funcionales; alimenta category_abundance y análisis diferenciales."
)

safe_write_tsv(
  genesets_summary,
  file.path(dir_qc, "06_resumen_KOs_por_categoria.tsv"),
  reason = "Registrar cuántos KOs fueron asignados a cada categoría funcional."
)

if (nrow(genesets_by_category) == 0) {
  log_msg("ERROR: Ningún KO fue asignado a categorías funcionales.")
  stop("No se detectaron genesets por categoría. Revisar ko_name y patrones originales.")
}

log_msg("Asignación de KOs a categorías completada.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.5 Construir abundancia por categoría
# ------------------------------------------------------------

log_msg("Construyendo category_abundance exactamente como en el protocolo base:")
log_msg("1) inner_join entre ko_by_sample y genesets_by_category.")
log_msg("2) Agrupar por category.")
log_msg("3) Sumar abundancias de todos los KOs dentro de cada categoría.")

category_abundance <- ko_by_sample %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    genesets_by_category,
    by = c("KO", "ko_name")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(sample_cols),
      sum
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

log_table(
  category_abundance,
  "06_category_abundance",
  n = 20
)

category_abundance_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  object = "category_abundance",
  n_rows = nrow(category_abundance),
  n_cols = ncol(category_abundance),
  categories = paste(category_abundance$category, collapse = " | ")
)

log_table(
  category_abundance_summary,
  "06_resumen_category_abundance",
  n = 10
)

safe_write_tsv(
  category_abundance,
  file.path(dir_tables, "category_abundance.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar abundancias sumadas por categoría funcional y muestra; esta tabla alimenta la transformación CLR por categoría."
)

safe_write_tsv(
  category_abundance_summary,
  file.path(dir_qc, "06_resumen_category_abundance.tsv"),
  reason = "Registrar dimensiones y categorías presentes en category_abundance."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.6 Revisión de abundancias por categoría y muestra
# ------------------------------------------------------------

category_sums_long <- category_abundance %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(sample_cols),
    names_to = "sample_column",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "sample_column") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category, Desierto) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_samples = dplyr::n(),
    min_abundance = min(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abundance = max(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abundance = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

log_table(
  category_sums_long,
  "06_revision_abundancias_por_categoria_desierto",
  n = 30
)

safe_write_tsv(
  category_sums_long,
  file.path(dir_qc, "06_revision_abundancias_por_categoria_desierto.tsv"),
  reason = "Revisar rangos de abundancia por categoría y desierto antes de la transformación composicional."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.7 Guardar objetos R
# ------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  category_patterns,
  file.path(dir_objects, "06_category_patterns.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  genesets_by_category,
  file.path(dir_objects, "06_genesets_by_category.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  category_abundance,
  file.path(dir_objects, "06_category_abundance.rds")
)

log_msg("Objetos R guardados:")
log_msg("- 06_category_patterns.rds")
log_msg("- 06_genesets_by_category.rds")
log_msg("- 06_category_abundance.rds")

log_msg("Archivos principales guardados:")
log_msg("- ", file.path(dir_tables, "genesets_by_category.tsv"))
log_msg("- ", file.path(dir_tables, "category_abundance.tsv"))

log_msg("Bloque 6 completado correctamente en modo reproducibilidad estricta.")
```

```{r bloque_6B_verificacion_categorias_salida, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 6B. VERIFICACIÓN ESTRICTA DE CATEGORÍAS DE SALIDA
# ============================================================

log_section("BLOQUE 6B. Verificación estricta de categorías de salida")

log_msg("Razón del bloque:")
log_msg("Verificar que las categorías funcionales generadas coincidan con el protocolo original.")

expected_output_categories <- c(
  "Glucosa_central",

  "Nitrogen",
  "Photosynthesis",
  "UV_repair"
)

category_output_check <- tibble::tibble(

  observed_in_current_run = category %in% observed_output_categories
)

)

missing_categories <- setdiff(expected_output_categories, observed_output_categories)
extra_categories <- setdiff(observed_output_categories, expected_output_categories)

  stop("Estructura no reproducible: hay categorías de salida adicionales.")
}

log_msg("Verificación correcta: las 5 categorías de salida coinciden con el protocolo original.")
log_msg("Categorías confirmadas: ", paste(observed_output_categories, collapse = " | "))

# Guardar también una tabla con el número de KOs por categoría,
# incluyendo explícitamente la categoría combinada.
genesets_category_counts <- genesets_by_category %>%
  dplyr::count(category, name = "n_KOs") %>%

log_table(

)

safe_write_tsv(

  reason = "Registrar cuántos KOs alimentan cada una de las 5 categorías finales del protocolo original."
)

saveRDS(
  expected_output_categories,
  file.path(dir_objects, "06B_expected_output_categories.rds")
)

log_msg("Bloque 6B completado correctamente.")
```

```{r bloque_7_transformacion_CLR, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 7. TRANSFORMACIÓN COMPOSICIONAL CLR
# ============================================================

log_section("BLOQUE 7. Transformación composicional CLR")

log_msg("Razón del bloque:")
log_msg("Aplicar la transformación composicional usada en el protocolo original.")
log_msg("Primero se convierten las abundancias a proporciones por muestra.")
log_msg("Después se agrega pseudoconteo por muestra: mitad del mínimo positivo.")
log_msg("Finalmente se aplica CLR = log(x) - media(log(x)) por muestra.")
log_msg("Este bloque genera las tablas que alimentan Wilcoxon, volcano plots, violines y lollipop plots.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7.1 Cargar objetos necesarios
# ------------------------------------------------------------

category_abundance <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "06_category_abundance.rds"))
genesets_by_category <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "06_genesets_by_category.rds"))
ko_by_sample <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "05_KO_by_sample.rds"))
sample_cols <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "02B_sample_cols.rds"))
metadata <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "03_metadata_ordenada_como_sample_cols.rds"))

log_msg("Objetos cargados:")
log_msg("- category_abundance")
log_msg("- genesets_by_category")
log_msg("- ko_by_sample")
log_msg("- sample_cols")
log_msg("- metadata")

log_msg("Dimensiones de category_abundance: ", nrow(category_abundance), " filas x ", ncol(category_abundance), " columnas")
log_msg("Dimensiones de ko_by_sample: ", nrow(ko_by_sample), " filas x ", ncol(ko_by_sample), " columnas")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7.2 Funciones originales de transformación composicional
# ------------------------------------------------------------

to_proportions <- function(df, sample_cols) {
  mat <- as.matrix(df[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
  col_sums <- colSums(mat)
  mat <- sweep(mat, 2, col_sums, FUN = "/")
  df[, sample_cols] <- mat
  df
}

pseudocount_per_sample <- function(df, sample_cols) {
  mat <- as.matrix(df[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(mat))) {
    col <- mat[, j]
    min_pos <- suppressWarnings(min(col[col > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.finite(min_pos)) {
      pseudo <- min_pos / 2
      col <- col + pseudo
    }
    mat[, j] <- col
  }
  df[, sample_cols] <- mat
  df
}

clr_transform <- function(df, sample_cols) {
  mat <- as.matrix(df[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
  log_mat <- log(mat)
  means <- colMeans(log_mat)
  clr_mat <- sweep(log_mat, 2, means, FUN = "-")
  df[, sample_cols] <- clr_mat
  df
}

log_msg("Funciones originales definidas:")
log_msg("- to_proportions()")
log_msg("- pseudocount_per_sample()")
log_msg("- clr_transform()")
log_msg("No se modificó la regla de pseudoconteo ni la fórmula CLR.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7.3 Control de sumas antes de proporciones
# ------------------------------------------------------------

category_col_sums_before <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_column = sample_cols,
  sum_category_abundance = sapply(sample_cols, function(s) sum(category_abundance[[s]], na.rm = TRUE))
)

ko_col_sums_before <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_column = sample_cols,
  sum_KO_abundance = sapply(sample_cols, function(s) sum(ko_by_sample[[s]], na.rm = TRUE))
)

log_table(
  category_col_sums_before,
  "07_sumas_category_abundance_antes_CLR",
  n = 30
)

log_table(
  ko_col_sums_before,
  "07_sumas_KO_by_sample_antes_CLR",
  n = 30
)

safe_write_tsv(
  category_col_sums_before,
  file.path(dir_qc, "07_sumas_category_abundance_antes_CLR.tsv"),
  reason = "Registrar las sumas por muestra antes de convertir categorías a proporciones."
)

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_col_sums_before,
  file.path(dir_qc, "07_sumas_KO_by_sample_antes_CLR.tsv"),
  reason = "Registrar las sumas por muestra antes de convertir KOs a proporciones."
)

if (any(category_col_sums_before$sum_category_abundance <= 0)) {
  log_msg("ERROR: Alguna muestra tiene suma cero en category_abundance.")
  stop("No se puede aplicar transformación composicional a category_abundance con suma cero.")
}

if (any(ko_col_sums_before$sum_KO_abundance <= 0)) {
  log_msg("ERROR: Alguna muestra tiene suma cero en ko_by_sample.")
  stop("No se puede aplicar transformación composicional a ko_by_sample con suma cero.")
}

log_msg("Verificación correcta: todas las muestras tienen suma positiva antes de la transformación.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7.4 CLR por categoría funcional
# ------------------------------------------------------------

log_msg("Aplicando transformación CLR a category_abundance con la lógica original.")

cat_clr <- category_abundance %>%
  to_proportions(sample_cols) %>%
  pseudocount_per_sample(sample_cols) %>%
  clr_transform(sample_cols)

log_table(
  cat_clr,
  "07_cat_clr",
  n = 10
)

cat_clr_long <- cat_clr %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(sample_cols),
    names_to = "sample_column",
    values_to = "CLR"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "sample_column")

log_table(
  cat_clr_long,
  "07_cat_clr_long",
  n = 20
)

safe_write_tsv(
  cat_clr,
  file.path(dir_tables, "cat_clr.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar abundancias CLR por categoría funcional y muestra."
)

safe_write_tsv(
  cat_clr_long,
  file.path(dir_tables, "cat_clr_long.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar tabla larga de CLR por categoría, muestra y desierto para análisis estadístico y violines."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7.5 Revisar datos válidos por categoría y desierto
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat_valid_counts <- cat_clr_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category, Desierto) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total = dplyr::n(),
    n_valid_CLR = sum(!is.na(CLR)),
    n_NA_CLR = sum(is.na(CLR)),
    min_CLR = min(CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_CLR = max(CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_CLR = mean(CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category, Desierto)

log_table(
  cat_valid_counts,
  "07_conteo_CLR_valido_por_categoria_desierto",
  n = 30
)

safe_write_tsv(
  cat_valid_counts,
  file.path(dir_qc, "07_conteo_CLR_valido_por_categoria_desierto.tsv"),
  reason = "Verificar que cada categoría tenga valores CLR válidos en CC y VG."
)

if (any(cat_valid_counts$n_valid_CLR == 0)) {
  log_msg("ERROR: Alguna categoría/desierto no tiene valores CLR válidos.")
  stop("No se puede continuar con estadística diferencial por categoría.")
}

log_msg("Verificación correcta: todas las categorías tienen valores CLR válidos por desierto.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7.6 CLR por KO
# ------------------------------------------------------------

log_msg("Construyendo matriz KO para transformación CLR.")

ko_abundance <- ko_by_sample %>%
  dplyr::select(KO, ko_name, dplyr::all_of(sample_cols))

ko_prevalence <- ko_abundance %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    prevalence = rowMeans(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(sample_cols), ~ .x > 0))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(KO, prevalence)

log_table(
  ko_prevalence,
  "07_ko_prevalence",
  n = 10
)

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_prevalence,
  file.path(dir_tables, "ko_prevalence.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar prevalencia de cada KO antes del filtro prevalence >= 0.20 usado en el protocolo original."
)

log_msg("Aplicando transformación CLR a KO abundance con la lógica original.")

ko_clr <- ko_abundance %>%
  to_proportions(sample_cols) %>%
  pseudocount_per_sample(sample_cols) %>%
  clr_transform(sample_cols)

log_table(
  ko_clr,
  "07_ko_clr",
  n = 10
)

ko_clr_long <- ko_clr %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(sample_cols),
    names_to = "sample_column",
    values_to = "CLR"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "sample_column") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(genesets_by_category, by = c("KO", "ko_name"))

log_table(
  ko_clr_long,
  "07_ko_clr_long",
  n = 20
)

safe_write_tsv(
```

```{r bloque_8_analisis_diferencial, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 8. ANÁLISIS DIFERENCIAL POR CATEGORÍA Y POR KO
# ============================================================

log_section("BLOQUE 8. Análisis diferencial por categoría y por KO")

log_msg("Razón del bloque:")
log_msg("Calcular diferencias de CLR entre desiertos usando el análisis base.")
log_msg("Se calcula diff_meanCLR = mean_CLR_VG - mean_CLR_CC.")
log_msg("Se usa Wilcoxon rank-sum test y corrección Benjamini-Hochberg.")
log_msg("También se calcula Cliff's delta como tamaño de efecto.")
log_msg("No se modifican umbrales ni fórmulas del protocolo original.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8.1 Cargar objetos necesarios
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat_clr_long <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "07_cat_clr_long.rds"))
ko_clr_long <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "07_ko_clr_long.rds"))
ko_prevalence <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "07_ko_prevalence.rds"))
sample_cols <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "02B_sample_cols.rds"))
metadata <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "03_metadata_ordenada_como_sample_cols.rds"))

log_msg("Objetos cargados:")
log_msg("- cat_clr_long")
log_msg("- ko_clr_long")
log_msg("- ko_prevalence")
log_msg("- sample_cols")
log_msg("- metadata")

log_msg("Dimensiones de cat_clr_long: ", nrow(cat_clr_long), " filas x ", ncol(cat_clr_long), " columnas")
log_msg("Dimensiones de ko_clr_long: ", nrow(ko_clr_long), " filas x ", ncol(ko_clr_long), " columnas")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8.2 Función original de Cliff's delta
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cliffs_delta <- function(x, g) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  g <- g[!is.na(g)]
  stopifnot(length(x) == length(g))
  
  grupos <- levels(factor(g))
  if (length(grupos) != 2) stop("cliffs_delta necesita exactamente 2 grupos.")
  
  x1 <- x[g == grupos[1]]
  x2 <- x[g == grupos[2]]
  
  diffs <- outer(x1, x2, "-")
  delta <- (sum(diffs > 0) - sum(diffs < 0)) / (length(x1) * length(x2))
  
  delta
}

log_msg("Función cliffs_delta() definida como en el protocolo base.")
log_msg("Nota: el orden de grupos se mantiene como CC y VG por el factor Desierto.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8.3 Verificación de datos por categoría antes de Wilcoxon
# ------------------------------------------------------------

category_test_input_check <- cat_clr_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category, Desierto) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    n_valid_CLR = sum(!is.na(CLR)),
    mean_CLR = mean(CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_CLR = sd(CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_CLR = min(CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_CLR = max(CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category, Desierto)

log_table(
  category_test_input_check,
  "08_revision_input_Wilcoxon_categoria",
  n = 30
)

safe_write_tsv(
  category_test_input_check,
  file.path(dir_qc, "08_revision_input_Wilcoxon_categoria.tsv"),
  reason = "Documentar los valores que alimentan Wilcoxon por categoría y desierto."
)

if (any(category_test_input_check$n_valid_CLR == 0)) {
  log_msg("ERROR: Hay categorías/desiertos sin valores CLR válidos.")
  stop("No se puede calcular Wilcoxon por categoría.")
}

log_msg("Verificación correcta: todas las categorías tienen valores CLR válidos en CC y VG.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8.4 Análisis diferencial por categoría
# ------------------------------------------------------------

log_msg("Calculando análisis diferencial por categoría.")
log_msg("Fórmula original: diff_meanCLR = mean_CLR_VG - mean_CLR_CC.")
log_msg("Prueba: wilcox.test(CLR[VG], CLR[CC]).")
log_msg("Corrección: p.adjust(p_value, method = 'BH').")

category_diff <- cat_clr_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_CC = sum(Desierto == "CC"),
    n_VG = sum(Desierto == "VG"),
    mean_CLR_CC = mean(CLR[Desierto == "CC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_CLR_VG = mean(CLR[Desierto == "VG"], na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_meanCLR = mean_CLR_VG - mean_CLR_CC,
    p_value = wilcox.test(CLR[Desierto == "VG"], CLR[Desierto == "CC"])$p.value,
    cliffs_delta = cliffs_delta(CLR, Desierto),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_adj)

log_table(
  category_diff,
  "08_category_diff",
  n = 20
)

safe_write_tsv(
  category_diff,
  file.path(dir_tables, "category_differential.tsv"),
  reason = "Tabla diferencial por categoría funcional; alimenta forest plot y resumen estadístico."
)

category_diff_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  object = "category_diff",
  n_categories = nrow(category_diff),
  min_p_value = min(category_diff$p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_p_value = max(category_diff$p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
  min_p_adj = min(category_diff$p_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_p_adj = max(category_diff$p_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_significant_q_0_05 = sum(category_diff$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_significant_q_0_10 = sum(category_diff$p_adj <= 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)
)

log_table(
  category_diff_summary,
  "08_resumen_category_diff",
  n = 10
)

safe_write_tsv(
  category_diff_summary,
  file.path(dir_qc, "08_resumen_category_diff.tsv"),
  reason = "Registrar resumen del análisis diferencial por categoría."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8.5 Verificación de datos por KO antes de Wilcoxon
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ko_test_input_check <- ko_clr_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category, KO, ko_name, Desierto) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    n_valid_CLR = sum(!is.na(CLR)),
    mean_CLR = mean(CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_CLR = sd(CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ko_test_summary <- ko_test_input_check %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category, Desierto) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_KO_desert_groups = dplyr::n(),
    min_n_valid_CLR = min(n_valid_CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_n_valid_CLR = max(n_valid_CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category, Desierto)

log_table(
  ko_test_summary,
  "08_revision_input_Wilcoxon_KO_resumen",
  n = 30
)

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_test_summary,
  file.path(dir_qc, "08_revision_input_Wilcoxon_KO_resumen.tsv"),
  reason = "Documentar que los KOs por categoría tienen valores para CC y VG antes de Wilcoxon."
)

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_test_input_check,
  file.path(dir_qc, "08_revision_input_Wilcoxon_KO_detalle.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar revisión detallada de valores por KO, categoría y desierto antes de Wilcoxon."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8.6 Análisis diferencial por KO
# ------------------------------------------------------------

log_msg("Calculando análisis diferencial por KO dentro de categorías.")
log_msg("Fórmula original: diff_meanCLR = mean_CLR_VG - mean_CLR_CC.")
log_msg("Prueba: wilcox.test(CLR[VG], CLR[CC]).")
log_msg("Filtro original posterior: prevalence >= 0.20.")
log_msg("Corrección BH aplicada después del filtro de prevalencia, como en el protocolo base.")

ko_diff_all <- ko_clr_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category, KO, ko_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_CC = sum(Desierto == "CC"),
    n_VG = sum(Desierto == "VG"),
    mean_CLR_CC = mean(CLR[Desierto == "CC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_CLR_VG = mean(CLR[Desierto == "VG"], na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_meanCLR = mean_CLR_VG - mean_CLR_CC,
    p_value = wilcox.test(CLR[Desierto == "VG"], CLR[Desierto == "CC"])$p.value,
    cliffs_delta = cliffs_delta(CLR, Desierto),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ko_prevalence,
    by = "KO"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(prevalence >= 0.20) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category, p_adj)

log_table(
  ko_diff_all,
  "08_ko_diff_all",
  n = 20
)

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_diff_all,
  file.path(dir_tables, "KO_differential_all_categories.tsv"),
  reason = "Tabla diferencial por KO dentro de categorías; alimenta volcano plots, heatmaps y lollipop plots."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8.7 Resumen del análisis diferencial por KO
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ko_diff_summary_by_category <- ko_diff_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_KOs_after_prevalence_filter = dplyr::n(),
    min_p_value = min(p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_p_value = max(p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_p_adj = min(p_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_p_adj = max(p_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_q_0_05 = sum(p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_q_0_10 = sum(p_adj <= 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_VG_enriched = sum(diff_meanCLR > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_CC_enriched = sum(diff_meanCLR < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category)

log_table(
  ko_diff_summary_by_category,
  "08_resumen_KO_differential_por_categoria",
  n = 20
)

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_diff_summary_by_category,
  file.path(dir_qc, "08_resumen_KO_differential_por_categoria.tsv"),
  reason = "Registrar número de KOs diferenciales por categoría y dirección de enriquecimiento."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8.8 Tabla específica de KOs significativos para lollipop/heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ko_sig_q_0_10 <- ko_diff_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_adj <= 0.1, !is.na(cliffs_delta)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    direction = dplyr::if_else(diff_meanCLR > 0, "VG>CC", "CC>VG")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category, p_adj)

log_table(
  ko_sig_q_0_10,
  "08_KOs_significativos_q_0_10",
  n = 30
)

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_sig_q_0_10,
  file.path(dir_tables, "KO_significant_q_0_10.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar KOs con q <= 0.1, usados en lollipop plots y heatmaps."
)

ko_sig_summary <- ko_sig_q_0_10 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category, direction) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_KOs = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category, direction)

log_table(
  ko_sig_summary,
  "08_resumen_KOs_significativos_q_0_10",
  n = 20
)

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_sig_summary,
  file.path(dir_qc, "08_resumen_KOs_significativos_q_0_10.tsv"),
  reason = "Registrar cuántos KOs significativos hay por categoría y dirección."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8.9 Guardar objetos R
# ------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  category_diff,
  file.path(dir_objects, "08_category_diff.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  ko_diff_all,
  file.path(dir_objects, "08_KO_differential_all_categories.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  ko_sig_q_0_10,
  file.path(dir_objects, "08_KO_significant_q_0_10.rds")
)

log_msg("Objetos R guardados:")
log_msg("- 08_category_diff.rds")
log_msg("- 08_KO_differential_all_categories.rds")
log_msg("- 08_KO_significant_q_0_10.rds")

log_msg("Archivos principales guardados:")
log_msg("- ", file.path(dir_tables, "category_differential.tsv"))
log_msg("- ", file.path(dir_tables, "KO_differential_all_categories.tsv"))
log_msg("- ", file.path(dir_tables, "KO_significant_q_0_10.tsv"))

log_msg("Bloque 8 completado correctamente en modo reproducibilidad estricta.")
```

```{r bloque_9_figura_violin_CLR_categoria, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ============================================================
```

```{r bloque_9P_violin_publication, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
category_diff <- readRDS(file.path(dir_objects, "08_category_diff.rds"))

log_msg("- 08_category_diff.rds")

# ------------------------------------------------------------

)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9P.3 Verificar que las categorías existan
# ------------------------------------------------------------

observed_categories <- sort(unique(as.character(cat_clr_long$category)))
missing_categories <- setdiff(category_order_pub, observed_categories)

category_check_pub <- tibble::tibble(
  category = category_order_pub,
  observed_in_cat_clr_long = category_order_pub %in% observed_categories
)

log_table(
  category_check_pub,
  "09P_verificacion_categorias_publication",
  n = 10
)

safe_write_tsv(
  category_check_pub,
  file.path(dir_qc, "09P_verificacion_categorias_publication.tsv"),
  reason = "Confirmar que las 5 categorías de publicación existen en cat_clr_long."
)

if (length(missing_categories) > 0) {
  log_msg("ERROR: Faltan categorías necesarias para la figura de publicación.")
  log_msg("Categorías faltantes: ", paste(missing_categories, collapse = ", "))
  stop("No se puede generar la figura de publicación porque faltan categorías.")
}

log_msg("Verificación correcta: las 5 categorías de publicación están presentes.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9P.4 Preparar tabla de graficación
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat_clr_long_pub <- cat_clr_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(category %in% category_order_pub) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = category_order_pub),
    category_label = factor(
      category_labels_en[as.character(category)],
      levels = unname(category_labels_en[category_order_pub])
    ),
    Desierto = factor(Desierto, levels = c("CC", "VG"))
  )

log_table(
  cat_clr_long_pub,
  "09P_tabla_graficacion_violin_publication",
  n = 20
)

safe_write_tsv(
  cat_clr_long_pub,
  file.path(dir_tables, "09P_tabla_graficacion_violin_publication.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar la tabla exacta usada para la figura de publicación del violin plot con las 5 categorías y el orden solicitado."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9P.5 Preparar tabla de anotaciones estadísticas
# ------------------------------------------------------------

category_stats_pub <- category_diff %>%
  dplyr::filter(category %in% category_order_pub) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = category_order_pub),
    category_label = factor(
      category_labels_en[as.character(category)],
      levels = unname(category_labels_en[category_order_pub])
    ),
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    q_label = paste0("q = ", signif(p_adj, 3)),
    stat_label = ifelse(
      significance == "ns",
      q_label,
      paste0(significance, "\n", q_label)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category)

# Posición vertical para las etiquetas estadísticas
y_positions <- cat_clr_long_pub %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category, category_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    y_max = max(CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_min = min(CLR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_pos = y_max + 0.12 * (y_max - y_min + 0.5)
  )

category_stats_pub <- category_stats_pub %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    y_positions,
    by = c("category", "category_label")
  )

log_table(
  category_stats_pub,
  "09P_category_stats_publication",
  n = 20
)

safe_write_tsv(
  category_stats_pub,
  file.path(dir_tables, "09P_category_stats_publication.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar la tabla de estadísticos usados para anotar la figura de publicación."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9P.6 Generar figura de publicación
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_violin_pub <- ggplot(
  cat_clr_long_pub,
  aes(x = category_label, y = CLR, fill = Desierto)
) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.55,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    color = "gray30",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Desierto),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.12,
      dodge.width = 0.8
    ),
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.75,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = category_stats_pub,
    aes(
      x = category_label,
      y = y_pos,
      label = stat_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.2,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("CC" = "#E9A4A0", "VG" = "mediumaquamarine"),
    labels = desert_labels_en,
    name = "Desert"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("CC" = "#E9A4A0", "VG" = "mediumaquamarine")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 20, 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CLR-transformed functional category abundance by desert",
    subtitle = "Each point represents one metagenomic sample (n = 9 per desert).",
    x = "Functional category",
    y = "CLR-transformed abundance",
    caption = paste(
      "Statistics: two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test comparing deserts within each category.",
      "P-values were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction.",
      "Asterisks indicate FDR-significant differences (* q < 0.05, ** q < 0.01, *** q < 0.001);",
      "'ns' indicates not significant.",
      sep = " "
    )
  )

print(p_violin_pub)

log_msg("Figura de publicación generada correctamente.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9P.7 Guardar figura
# ------------------------------------------------------------

safe_ggsave(
  filename = "Figure_01_violin_category_CLR_publication.png",
  plot = p_violin_pub,
  width = 9.5,
  height = 6.8,
  dpi = 300,
  reason = "Guardar versión PNG de publicación del violin plot en inglés con las 5 categorías en el orden solicitado."
)

safe_ggsave(
  filename = "Figure_01_violin_category_CLR_publication.pdf",
  plot = p_violin_pub,
  width = 9.5,
  height = 6.8,
  reason = "Guardar versión PDF de publicación del violin plot en inglés con las 5 categorías en el orden solicitado."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9P.8 Guardar objeto R
# ------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  p_violin_pub,
  file.path(dir_objects, "09P_p_violin_publication.rds")
)

log_msg("Archivos guardados:")
log_msg("- ", file.path(dir_figures, "Figure_01_violin_category_CLR_publication.png"))
log_msg("- ", file.path(dir_figures, "Figure_01_violin_category_CLR_publication.pdf"))
log_msg("- ", file.path(dir_tables, "09P_category_stats_publication.tsv"))
log_msg("- 09P_p_violin_publication.rds")

log_msg("Bloque 9P completado correctamente.")
```

```{r bloque_10_volcano_plots_publication, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 10. VOLCANO PLOTS POR CATEGORÍA FUNCIONAL
# ============================================================

log_section("BLOQUE 10. Volcano plots por categoría funcional")

log_msg("Razón del bloque:")
log_msg("Generar volcano plots por categoría funcional usando la tabla diferencial de KOs.")
log_msg("No se recalculan pruebas estadísticas ni valores; se usa KO_differential_all_categories del Bloque 8.")
log_msg("Los volcano plots muestran diff_meanCLR en el eje X y -log10(q) en el eje Y.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.1 Cargar tabla diferencial por KO
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ko_diff_all <- readRDS(
  file.path(dir_objects, "08_KO_differential_all_categories.rds")
)

log_msg("Objeto cargado: 08_KO_differential_all_categories.rds")
log_msg("Dimensiones de ko_diff_all: ", nrow(ko_diff_all), " filas x ", ncol(ko_diff_all), " columnas")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.2 Definir orden y etiquetas de categorías
# ------------------------------------------------------------

category_order_pub <- c(
  "Glucosa_central",
  "Glucosa_central;UV_repair",
  "UV_repair",
  "Nitrogen",
  "Photosynthesis"
)

category_labels_en <- c(
  "Glucosa_central" = "Central glucose metabolism",
  "Glucosa_central;UV_repair" = "Central glucose metabolism + UV repair",
  "UV_repair" = "UV repair",
  "Nitrogen" = "Nitrogen metabolism",
  "Photosynthesis" = "Photosynthesis"
)

# Verificación de categorías
observed_categories <- sort(unique(as.character(ko_diff_all$category)))
missing_categories <- setdiff(category_order_pub, observed_categories)

category_check_volcano <- tibble::tibble(
  category = category_order_pub,
  observed_in_ko_diff_all = category_order_pub %in% observed_categories
)

log_table(
  category_check_volcano,
  "10_verificacion_categorias_volcano",
  n = 10
)

safe_write_tsv(
  category_check_volcano,
  file.path(dir_qc, "10_verificacion_categorias_volcano.tsv"),
  reason = "Confirmar que las categorías esperadas existen en la tabla diferencial por KO."
)

if (length(missing_categories) > 0) {
  log_msg("ERROR: Faltan categorías esperadas para los volcano plots.")
  log_msg("Categorías faltantes: ", paste(missing_categories, collapse = ", "))
  stop("No se pueden generar volcano plots porque faltan categorías.")
}

log_msg("Verificación correcta: las 5 categorías están presentes para volcano plots.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.3 Preparar tabla para volcano plots
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ko_diff_volcano <- ko_diff_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(category %in% category_order_pub) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = category_order_pub),
    category_label = category_labels_en[as.character(category)],
    neg_log10_q = -log10(p_adj),
    direction = dplyr::if_else(
      diff_meanCLR > 0,
      "VG > CC",
      "CC > VG"
    ),
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      p_adj < 0.05 & diff_meanCLR > 0 ~ "Significant, VG > CC",
      p_adj < 0.05 & diff_meanCLR < 0 ~ "Significant, CC > VG",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

log_table(
  ko_diff_volcano,
  "10_tabla_para_volcano_plots",
  n = 20
)

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_diff_volcano,
  file.path(dir_tables, "10_tabla_para_volcano_plots.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar la tabla exacta que alimenta los volcano plots por categoría."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.4 Resumen de puntos por categoría
# ------------------------------------------------------------

volcano_summary <- ko_diff_volcano %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category, category_label, significance) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_KOs = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category, significance)

log_table(
  volcano_summary,
  "10_resumen_puntos_volcano",
  n = 30
)

safe_write_tsv(
  volcano_summary,
  file.path(dir_qc, "10_resumen_puntos_volcano.tsv"),
  reason = "Registrar cuántos KOs aparecen en cada volcano plot y cuántos son significativos."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.5 Generar volcano plots individuales
# ------------------------------------------------------------

volcano_plots <- list()

for (cat_i in category_order_pub) {
  
  df_cat <- ko_diff_volcano %>%
    dplyr::filter(category == cat_i)
  
  cat_label <- category_labels_en[[cat_i]]
  
  log_msg("Generando volcano plot para: ", cat_label)
  log_msg("Número de KOs en esta categoría: ", nrow(df_cat))
  
  p_volcano <- ggplot(
    df_cat,
    aes(x = diff_meanCLR, y = neg_log10_q)
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = significance),
      alpha = 0.75,
      size = 2
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dotted",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Significant, VG > CC" = "mediumaquamarine",
        "Significant, CC > VG" = "#E9A4A0",
        "Not significant" = "gray70"
      ),
      breaks = c(
        "Significant, CC > VG",
        "Significant, VG > CC",
        "Not significant"
      ),
      name = "Differential signal"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      subtitle = cat_label,
      x = expression(Delta~"mean CLR abundance (VG - CC)"),
      y = expression(-log[10]~"(FDR-adjusted q-value)"),
      caption = paste(
        "Each point represents one KO assigned to this functional category.",
        "",
        "The horizontal dotted line indicates q = 0.05.",
        "Positive values indicate enrichment in Valle de Guadalupe; negative values indicate enrichment in Cuatro Ciénegas.",
        sep = " "
      )
    )
  
  print(p_volcano)
  
  volcano_plots[[cat_i]] <- p_volcano
  
  file_stub <- paste0(
    "Figure_volcano_KO_",
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", cat_i)
  )
  
  safe_ggsave(
    filename = paste0(file_stub, "_publication.png"),
    plot = p_volcano,
    width = 7.5,
    height = 5.5,
    dpi = 300,
    reason = paste0("Guardar volcano plot PNG para la categoría: ", cat_label)
  )
  
  safe_ggsave(
    filename = paste0(file_stub, "_publication.pdf"),
    plot = p_volcano,
    width = 7.5,
    height = 5.5,
    reason = paste0("Guardar volcano plot PDF para la categoría: ", cat_label)
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.6 Guardar lista de objetos ggplot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  volcano_plots,
  file.path(dir_objects, "10_volcano_plots_publication.rds")
)

log_msg("Objeto R guardado:")
log_msg("- 10_volcano_plots_publication.rds")

log_msg("Bloque 10 completado correctamente.")
```

```{r bloque_10B_volcano_plots_publication_labels, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 10B. VOLCANO PLOTS CON ETIQUETAS DE KOs PRINCIPALES
# ============================================================

log_section("BLOQUE 10B. Volcano plots con etiquetas de KOs principales")

log_msg("Razón del bloque:")
log_msg("Generar una segunda versión de los volcano plots con etiquetas para los KOs más relevantes.")
log_msg("No se recalculan valores ni pruebas estadísticas.")
log_msg("Las etiquetas son una decisión visual de publicación basada en q < 0.05 y magnitud de efecto.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10B.1 Cargar librería adicional para etiquetas
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"ggrepel" %in% rownames(installed.packages())) {
  log_msg("Paquete faltante detectado: ggrepel")
  log_msg("Se instalará porque permite colocar etiquetas sin que se encimen.")
  install.packages("ggrepel")
}

library(ggrepel)

log_msg("Librería ggrepel cargada correctamente.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10B.2 Cargar tabla diferencial por KO
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ko_diff_all <- readRDS(
  file.path(dir_objects, "08_KO_differential_all_categories.rds")
)

log_msg("Objeto cargado: 08_KO_differential_all_categories.rds")
log_msg("Dimensiones de ko_diff_all: ", nrow(ko_diff_all), " filas x ", ncol(ko_diff_all), " columnas")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10B.3 Definir orden y etiquetas de categorías
# ------------------------------------------------------------

category_order_pub <- c(
  "Glucosa_central",
  "Glucosa_central;UV_repair",
  "UV_repair",
  "Nitrogen",
  "Photosynthesis"
)

category_labels_en <- c(
  "Glucosa_central" = "Central glucose metabolism",
  "Glucosa_central;UV_repair" = "Central glucose metabolism + UV repair",
  "UV_repair" = "UV repair",
  "Nitrogen" = "Nitrogen metabolism",
  "Photosynthesis" = "Photosynthesis"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10B.4 Preparar tabla base para volcano
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ko_diff_volcano <- ko_diff_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(category %in% category_order_pub) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = category_order_pub),
    category_label = category_labels_en[as.character(category)],
    neg_log10_q = -log10(p_adj),
    direction = dplyr::if_else(
      diff_meanCLR > 0,
      "VG > CC",
      "CC > VG"
    ),
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      p_adj < 0.05 & diff_meanCLR > 0 ~ "Significant, VG > CC",
      p_adj < 0.05 & diff_meanCLR < 0 ~ "Significant, CC > VG",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    ko_label = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(ko_name) & ko_name != "",
      paste0(KO, "\n", stringr::str_trunc(ko_name, width = 45)),
      KO
    )
  )

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_diff_volcano,
  file.path(dir_tables, "10B_tabla_base_volcano_labels.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar la tabla base usada para volcano plots con etiquetas."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10B.5 Seleccionar KOs que serán etiquetados
# ------------------------------------------------------------

top_n_labels <- 10

label_selection <- ko_diff_volcano %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_adj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_adj, dplyr::desc(abs(diff_meanCLR)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n_labels) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_reason = paste0(
      "q < 0.05; selected among top ",
      top_n_labels,
      " by lowest q and largest absolute diff_meanCLR"
    )
  )

log_table(
  label_selection,
  "10B_KOs_etiquetados_volcano",
  n = 50
)

safe_write_tsv(
  label_selection,
  file.path(dir_tables, "10B_KOs_etiquetados_volcano.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar los KOs seleccionados para etiquetarse en la segunda versión de los volcano plots."
)

label_summary <- label_selection %>%
  dplyr::count(category, category_label, name = "n_labeled_KOs") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category)

log_table(
  label_summary,
  "10B_resumen_KOs_etiquetados_por_categoria",
  n = 20
)

safe_write_tsv(
  label_summary,
  file.path(dir_qc, "10B_resumen_KOs_etiquetados_por_categoria.tsv"),
  reason = "Registrar cuántos KOs se etiquetan por categoría."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10B.6 Generar volcano plots individuales con etiquetas
# ------------------------------------------------------------

volcano_plots_labeled <- list()

for (cat_i in category_order_pub) {
  
  df_cat <- ko_diff_volcano %>%
    dplyr::filter(category == cat_i)
  
  df_labels <- label_selection %>%
    dplyr::filter(category == cat_i)
  
  cat_label <- category_labels_en[[cat_i]]
  
  log_msg("Generando volcano plot etiquetado para: ", cat_label)
  log_msg("Número total de KOs en esta categoría: ", nrow(df_cat))
  log_msg("Número de KOs etiquetados: ", nrow(df_labels))
  
  p_volcano_labeled <- ggplot(
    df_cat,
    aes(x = diff_meanCLR, y = neg_log10_q)
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = significance),
      alpha = 0.75,
      size = 2
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dotted",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = df_labels,
      aes(label = ko_label),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.25,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      segment.linewidth = 0.25,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Significant, VG > CC" = "mediumaquamarine",
        "Significant, CC > VG" = "#E9A4A0",
        "Not significant" = "gray70"
      ),
      breaks = c(
        "Significant, CC > VG",
        "Significant, VG > CC",
        "Not significant"
      ),
      name = "Differential signal"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      subtitle = cat_label,
      x = expression(Delta~"mean CLR abundance (VG - CC)"),
      y = expression(-log[10]~"(FDR-adjusted q-value)"),
      caption = paste(
        "Each point represents one KO assigned to this functional category.",
        "Labeled KOs correspond to FDR-significant features (q < 0.05), with up to 10 labels per category.",
        "The vertical dashed line indicates no difference between deserts.",
        "The horizontal dotted line indicates q = 0.05.",
        "Positive values indicate enrichment in Valle de Guadalupe; negative values indicate enrichment in Cuatro Ciénegas.",
        sep = " "
      )
    )
  
  print(p_volcano_labeled)
  
  volcano_plots_labeled[[cat_i]] <- p_volcano_labeled
  
  file_stub <- paste0(
    "Figure_volcano_KO_",
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", cat_i),
    "_labeled"
  )
  
  safe_ggsave(
    filename = paste0(file_stub, "_publication.png"),
    plot = p_volcano_labeled,
    width = 8.2,
    height = 5.8,
    dpi = 300,
    reason = paste0("Guardar volcano plot etiquetado PNG para la categoría: ", cat_label)
  )
  
  safe_ggsave(
    filename = paste0(file_stub, "_publication.pdf"),
    plot = p_volcano_labeled,
    width = 8.2,
    height = 5.8,
    reason = paste0("Guardar volcano plot etiquetado PDF para la categoría: ", cat_label)
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10B.7 Guardar objetos R
# ------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  volcano_plots_labeled,
  file.path(dir_objects, "10B_volcano_plots_labeled_publication.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  label_selection,
  file.path(dir_objects, "10B_KOs_etiquetados_volcano.rds")
)

log_msg("Objetos R guardados:")
log_msg("- 10B_volcano_plots_labeled_publication.rds")
log_msg("- 10B_KOs_etiquetados_volcano.rds")

log_msg("Bloque 10B completado correctamente.")
```
```{r bloque_10C_tabla_publicacion_KOs_etiquetados, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 10C. TABLA DE PUBLICACIÓN PARA KOs ETIQUETADOS EN VOLCANO PLOTS
# ============================================================

log_section("BLOQUE 10C. Tabla de publicación para KOs etiquetados")

log_msg("Razón del bloque:")
log_msg("Generar una tabla de publicación con los KOs etiquetados en los volcano plots.")
log_msg("No se recalculan valores; se usa directamente 10B_KOs_etiquetados_volcano.tsv.")
log_msg("La tabla resume categoría, KO, anotación funcional, dirección de enriquecimiento, q-value y tamaño de efecto.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10C.1 Cargar paquetes necesarios
# ------------------------------------------------------------

packages_needed_10C <- c("gt", "dplyr", "readr", "stringr", "tibble")

packages_missing_10C <- packages_needed_10C[
  !packages_needed_10C %in% rownames(installed.packages())
]

if (length(packages_missing_10C) > 0) {
  log_msg("Paquetes faltantes para tabla de publicación: ", paste(packages_missing_10C, collapse = ", "))
  install.packages(packages_missing_10C)
}

invisible(lapply(packages_needed_10C, library, character.only = TRUE))

log_msg("Paquetes para tabla de publicación cargados correctamente.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10C.2 Leer tabla de KOs etiquetados
# ------------------------------------------------------------

labeled_kos_path <- file.path(
  dir_tables,
  "10B_KOs_etiquetados_volcano.tsv"
)

if (!file.exists(labeled_kos_path)) {
  log_msg("ERROR: No se encontró la tabla 10B_KOs_etiquetados_volcano.tsv.")
  log_msg("Ruta esperada: ", labeled_kos_path)
  stop("No se puede construir la tabla de publicación sin 10B_KOs_etiquetados_volcano.tsv.")
}

labeled_kos <- readr::read_tsv(
  labeled_kos_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

log_table(
  labeled_kos,
  "10C_labeled_kos_original",
  n = 20
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10C.3 Verificar columnas necesarias
# ------------------------------------------------------------

required_cols_10C <- c(
  "category",
  "KO",
  "ko_name",
  "diff_meanCLR",
  "p_adj",
  "cliffs_delta",
  "prevalence",
  "direction"
)

missing_cols_10C <- setdiff(required_cols_10C, colnames(labeled_kos))

if (length(missing_cols_10C) > 0) {
  log_msg("ERROR: Faltan columnas necesarias para la tabla de publicación.")
  log_msg("Columnas faltantes: ", paste(missing_cols_10C, collapse = ", "))
  stop("No se puede construir la tabla de publicación porque faltan columnas.")
}

log_msg("Verificación correcta: la tabla contiene todas las columnas necesarias.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10C.4 Definir orden y etiquetas en inglés
# ------------------------------------------------------------

category_order_pub <- c(
  "Glucosa_central",
  "Glucosa_central;UV_repair",
  "UV_repair",
  "Nitrogen",
  "Photosynthesis"
)

category_labels_en <- c(
  "Glucosa_central" = "Central glucose metabolism",
  "Glucosa_central;UV_repair" = "Central glucose metabolism + UV repair",
  "UV_repair" = "UV repair",
  "Nitrogen" = "Nitrogen metabolism",
  "Photosynthesis" = "Photosynthesis"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10C.5 Crear tabla cruda ordenada para trazabilidad
# ------------------------------------------------------------

labeled_kos_publication_raw <- labeled_kos %>%
  dplyr::filter(category %in% category_order_pub) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = category_order_pub),
    Functional_category = category_labels_en[as.character(category)],
    Enriched_desert = dplyr::case_when(
      direction == "VG > CC" | direction == "VG>CC" ~ "Valle de Guadalupe (VG)",
      direction == "CC > VG" | direction == "CC>VG" ~ "Cuatro Ciénegas (CC)",
      diff_meanCLR > 0 ~ "Valle de Guadalupe (VG)",
      diff_meanCLR < 0 ~ "Cuatro Ciénegas (CC)",
      TRUE ~ "No direction"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category, p_adj, dplyr::desc(abs(diff_meanCLR)))

safe_write_tsv(
  labeled_kos_publication_raw,
  file.path(dir_tables, "10C_labeled_KOs_publication_raw.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar tabla cruda de KOs etiquetados, ordenada y con etiquetas en inglés, sin redondear valores."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10C.6 Crear tabla formateada para figura/publicación
# ------------------------------------------------------------

labeled_kos_publication_display <- labeled_kos_publication_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    `Functional category` = Functional_category,
    KO = KO,
    `Functional annotation` = ko_name,
    `Enriched desert` = Enriched_desert,
    `Δ mean CLR\n(VG - CC)` = round(diff_meanCLR, 3),
    `FDR q-value` = signif(p_adj, 3),
    `Cliff's δ` = round(cliffs_delta, 3),
    Prevalence = round(prevalence, 2)
  )

log_table(
  labeled_kos_publication_display,
  "10C_labeled_kos_publication_display",
  n = 30
)

safe_write_tsv(
  labeled_kos_publication_display,
  file.path(dir_tables, "10C_labeled_KOs_publication_display.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar tabla formateada para publicación con valores redondeados solo para visualización."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10C.7 Generar tabla gt para publicación
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gt_labeled_kos <- labeled_kos_publication_display %>%
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Functional category") %>%
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**Key labeled KOs from volcano plots**"),
    subtitle = gt::md("Differentially enriched KOs selected for volcano plot labels")
  ) %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    KO = "KO",
    `Functional annotation` = "Functional annotation",
    `Enriched desert` = "Enriched desert",
    `Δ mean CLR\n(VG - CC)` = gt::md("Δ mean CLR<br>(VG − CC)"),
    `FDR q-value` = "FDR q-value",
    `Cliff's δ` = gt::md("Cliff's δ"),
    Prevalence = "Prevalence"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups()
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size = gt::px(11),
    heading.title.font.size = gt::px(15),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = gt::px(12),
    row_group.font.weight = "bold",
    table.width = gt::pct(100),
    data_row.padding = gt::px(3)
  ) %>%
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(KO, `Enriched desert`, `Δ mean CLR\n(VG - CC)`, `FDR q-value`, `Cliff's δ`, Prevalence)
  ) %>%
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(`Functional annotation`)
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = gt::md(
      "Statistics: two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test comparing deserts; p-values were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction. Δ mean CLR = mean CLR abundance in VG − mean CLR abundance in CC. Cliff's δ indicates effect size."
    )
  )

gt_labeled_kos

log_msg("Tabla gt de publicación generada correctamente.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10C.8 Guardar tabla en HTML y PNG
# ------------------------------------------------------------

table_html_path <- file.path(
  dir_figures,
  "Table_01_labeled_KOs_from_volcano_plots_publication.html"
)

gt::gtsave(
  data = gt_labeled_kos,
  filename = table_html_path
)

log_msg("Tabla HTML guardada:")
log_msg(table_html_path)

table_png_path <- file.path(
  dir_figures,
  "Table_01_labeled_KOs_from_volcano_plots_publication.png"
)

tryCatch({
  gt::gtsave(
    data = gt_labeled_kos,
    filename = table_png_path
  )
  log_msg("Tabla PNG guardada:")
  log_msg(table_png_path)
}, error = function(e) {
  log_msg("No se pudo guardar la tabla como PNG automáticamente.")
  log_msg("Detalle: ", e$message)
  log_msg("La tabla sí quedó guardada como HTML. Puedes abrir el HTML y exportarlo/capturarlo si es necesario.")
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10C.9 Guardar objeto R
# ------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  gt_labeled_kos,
  file.path(dir_objects, "10C_gt_labeled_KOs_publication.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  labeled_kos_publication_raw,
  file.path(dir_objects, "10C_labeled_KOs_publication_raw.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  labeled_kos_publication_display,
  file.path(dir_objects, "10C_labeled_KOs_publication_display.rds")
)

log_msg("Objetos R guardados:")
log_msg("- 10C_gt_labeled_KOs_publication.rds")
log_msg("- 10C_labeled_KOs_publication_raw.rds")
log_msg("- 10C_labeled_KOs_publication_display.rds")

log_msg("Bloque 10C completado correctamente.")
```

```{r bloque_11_lollipop_plots_publication, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 11. LOLLIPOP PLOTS DE KOs POR TAMAÑO DE EFECTO
# ============================================================

log_section("BLOQUE 11. Lollipop plots de KOs por tamaño de efecto")

log_msg("Razón del bloque:")
log_msg("Generar lollipop plots para visualizar los KOs con mayor tamaño de efecto.")
log_msg("No se recalculan valores estadísticos; se usa KO_differential_all_categories del Bloque 8.")
log_msg("El criterio original se conserva: KOs con q <= 0.1 y ranking por abs(Cliff's delta).")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.1 Cargar tabla diferencial por KO
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ko_diff_all <- readRDS(
  file.path(dir_objects, "08_KO_differential_all_categories.rds")
)

log_msg("Objeto cargado: 08_KO_differential_all_categories.rds")
log_msg("Dimensiones de ko_diff_all: ", nrow(ko_diff_all), " filas x ", ncol(ko_diff_all), " columnas")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.2 Definir orden y etiquetas de categorías
# ------------------------------------------------------------

category_order_pub <- c(
  "Glucosa_central",
  "Glucosa_central;UV_repair",
  "UV_repair",
  "Nitrogen",
  "Photosynthesis"
)

category_labels_en <- c(
  "Glucosa_central" = "Central glucose metabolism",
  "Glucosa_central;UV_repair" = "Central glucose metabolism + UV repair",
  "UV_repair" = "UV repair",
  "Nitrogen" = "Nitrogen metabolism",
  "Photosynthesis" = "Photosynthesis"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.3 Preparar tabla de KOs significativos para lollipop
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alpha_lollipop <- 0.1
top_n_effect <- 10

ko_lollipop_base <- ko_diff_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    category %in% category_order_pub,
    !is.na(cliffs_delta),
    p_adj <= alpha_lollipop
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = category_order_pub),
    category_label = category_labels_en[as.character(category)],
    direction = dplyr::if_else(diff_meanCLR > 0, "VG > CC", "CC > VG"),
    enriched_desert = dplyr::if_else(
      diff_meanCLR > 0,
      "Valle de Guadalupe (VG)",
      "Cuatro Ciénegas (CC)"
    ),
    base_label = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(ko_name) & ko_name != "",
      ko_name,
      KO
    ),
    label_short = stringr::str_trunc(base_label, width = 55),
    label_plot = paste0(KO, " | ", label_short)
  )

log_table(
  ko_lollipop_base,
  "11_KOs_base_lollipop_q_0_10",
  n = 30
)

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_lollipop_base,
  file.path(dir_tables, "11_KOs_base_lollipop_q_0_10.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar KOs con q <= 0.1 usados como base para los lollipop plots."
)

if (nrow(ko_lollipop_base) == 0) {
  log_msg("ERROR: No hay KOs con q <= 0.1 para generar lollipop plots.")
  stop("No se pueden generar lollipop plots sin KOs significativos bajo el criterio original.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.4 Seleccionar top KOs por categoría
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ko_lollipop_by_category <- ko_lollipop_base %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category, category_label) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = abs(cliffs_delta),
    n = top_n_effect,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category, dplyr::desc(abs(cliffs_delta)))

log_table(
  ko_lollipop_by_category,
  "11_top_KOs_lollipop_por_categoria",
  n = 50
)

safe_write_tsv(
  ko_lollipop_by_category,
  file.path(dir_tables, "11_top_KOs_lollipop_por_categoria.tsv"),
  reason = "Guardar los top KOs por categoría seleccionados por mayor abs(Cliff's delta)."
)

lollipop_summary <- ko_lollipop_by_category %>%
  dplyr::count(category, category_label, direction, name = "n_KOs") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(category, direction)

log_table(
  lollipop_summary,
  "11_resumen_top_KOs_lollipop_por_categoria",
  n = 30
)

safe_write_tsv(
  lollipop_summary,
  file.path(dir_qc, "11_resumen_top_KOs_lollipop_por_categoria.tsv"),
  reason = "Registrar cuántos KOs se grafican por categoría y dirección."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.5 Lollipop individual por categoría
# ------------------------------------------------------------

lollipop_plots_individual <- list()

for (cat_i in category_order_pub) {
  
  df_cat <- ko_lollipop_by_category %>%
    dplyr::filter(category == cat_i) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label_plot = forcats::fct_reorder(label_plot, cliffs_delta)
    )
  
  cat_label <- category_labels_en[[cat_i]]
  
  if (nrow(df_cat) == 0) {
    log_msg("No hay KOs significativos para lollipop en categoría: ", cat_label)
    next
  }
  
  log_msg("Generando lollipop individual para: ", cat_label)
  log_msg("Número de KOs graficados: ", nrow(df_cat))
  
  p_lollipop_cat <- ggplot(
    df_cat,
    aes(x = label_plot, y = cliffs_delta, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(xend = label_plot, y = 0, yend = cliffs_delta),
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "VG > CC" = "mediumaquamarine",
        "CC > VG" = "#E9A4A0"
      ),
      name = "Enriched desert"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      subtitle = cat_label,
      x = "KO functional annotation",
      y = "Cliff's delta",
      caption = paste(
        "KOs shown have FDR-adjusted q <= 0.1.",
        "KOs were ranked by absolute Cliff's delta within each category.",
        "Positive values indicate enrichment in Valle de Guadalupe; negative values indicate enrichment in Cuatro Ciénegas.",
        sep = " "
      )
    )
  
  print(p_lollipop_cat)
  
  lollipop_plots_individual[[cat_i]] <- p_lollipop_cat
  
  file_stub <- paste0(
    "Figure_lollipop_KO_",
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", cat_i),
    "_publication"
  )
  
  safe_ggsave(
    filename = paste0(file_stub, ".png"),
    plot = p_lollipop_cat,
    width = 8.8,
    height = 5.8,
    dpi = 300,
    reason = paste0("Guardar lollipop plot individual PNG para: ", cat_label)
  )
  
  safe_ggsave(
    filename = paste0(file_stub, ".pdf"),
    plot = p_lollipop_cat,
    width = 8.8,
    height = 5.8,
    reason = paste0("Guardar lollipop plot individual PDF para: ", cat_label)
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.6 Lollipop combinado facetado por categoría
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ko_lollipop_facet <- ko_lollipop_by_category %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category_label = factor(
      category_label,
      levels = unname(category_labels_en[category_order_pub])
    ),
    label_facet = paste0(KO, " | ", stringr::str_trunc(base_label, width = 45))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category_label) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_facet = forcats::fct_reorder(label_facet, cliffs_delta)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

p_lollipop_facet <- ggplot(
  ko_lollipop_facet,
  aes(x = label_facet, y = cliffs_delta, color = direction)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = label_facet, y = 0, yend = cliffs_delta),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ category_label,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "VG > CC" = "mediumaquamarine",
      "CC > VG" = "#E9A4A0"
    ),

  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +

    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL,
    x = "KO functional annotation",
    y = "Cliff's delta",
    caption = paste(
      "KOs shown have FDR-adjusted q <= 0.1.",
      "Up to 10 KOs per category are shown, ranked by absolute Cliff's delta.",

      sep = " "

print(p_lollipop_facet)

)

top_n_global <- 40
```

```{r bloque_12_reporte_reproducibilidad, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
safe_scalar <- function(x, fallback = "Not available") {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(fallback)
  }
  as.character(x[1])
}

analysis_name_safe <- if (exists("params") && !is.null(params$analysis_name)) {
  safe_scalar(params$analysis_name)
} else {
  safe_scalar(basename(project_dir))
}

base_dir_safe <- if (exists("base_dir")) {
  safe_scalar(base_dir)
} else {
  "Not available"
}

project_dir_safe <- if (exists("project_dir")) {
  safe_scalar(project_dir)
} else {
  "Not available"
}

  ),
  value = c(

    base_dir_safe,
    project_dir_safe,
    as.character(Sys.time()),

    paste(

    ),
    safe_scalar(sys_info[["user"]]),
    "Strict reproducibility: no analytical filters, thresholds, transformations or tests were modified."

)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.3 Función para inventariar archivos con checksum
# ------------------------------------------------------------

inventory_files <- function(paths, label) {
  paths <- unique(paths[file.exists(paths)])
  
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        file_group = character(),
        file_name = character(),
        path = character(),
        size_MB = numeric(),
        modified_time = character(),
        md5 = character()
      )
    )
  }
  
  info <- file.info(paths)
  
  tibble::tibble(
    file_group = label,
    file_name = basename(paths),
    path = paths,
    size_MB = round(info$size / 1024^2, 4),
    modified_time = as.character(info$mtime),
    md5 = as.character(tools::md5sum(paths))
  )
}
```
